caption: The drawing depicts a metal coffee pot with a tall, conical body, a curved spout on the left, and a large, arched handle on the right. The coffee pot is predominantly painted in a bright red color with visible areas of chipping and wear, revealing some metal underneath. Decorative yellow, green, and black patterns encircle the pot near the top and bottom. The topmost band features yellow scallop shapes, while the central decorative band consists of yellow swirls and circular yellow flower-like motifs with green leaves and black accents against a white background. The lid, also red, is decorated with yellow shapes and has a small, dark knob on top. The base of the pot features a similar yellow scallop design as the lid. The artist's name, "HARRY GROSSEN," appears lightly in the lower right corner of the image. The background consists of a plain off-white or beige color with a slightly darker rectangular border behind the coffee pot.
title: Toleware Tin Coffee Pot
